data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Iandelos', meaning 'God's generous gift' or 'Jesus' little one'. In the New Testament, the name Iandelos is associated with a disciple of Jesus who was known for his generosity and devotion. The name Jandel carries the meaning “God's generous gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jandel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's generous gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
